safetyHeroData.heading: Our Privacy Policy
safetyHeroData.description: Welcome to Fizzzbee, a matrimonial website and app designed to connect individuals for potential marriage. Your privacy is important to us, and this Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, protect, and share your personal information.

guidelinesData.title: How We Use Your Information
guidelinesData.description: We use your information for the following purposes:
steps: To create and manage your profile.
To connect you with compatible matches based on your preferences.
To improve user experience and provide customer support.
To monitor and prevent fraudulent activities.
To comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms of service.

guidelinesData.title: Sharing of Information
guidelinesData.description: We do not sell or rent your personal information. However, we may share it in the following cases:
steps: With Other Users: Profile information (excluding contact details) is visible to registered users.
With Service Providers: Trusted third-party vendors assisting in platform operations, such as payment processing and security verification.
For Legal Reasons: If required by law, court orders, or to prevent fraud or harm.

guidelinesData.title: Data Security
guidelinesData.description: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

guidelinesData.title: Your Privacy Choices
guidelinesData.description: You can control your privacy settings in the following ways:
steps: Edit or delete your profile at any time.
Request access, modification, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us.

guidelinesData.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
guidelinesData.description: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience, analyze site traffic, and enhance security. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

guidelinesData.title: Children’s Privacy
guidelinesData.description: Fizzzbee is intended for users 18 years and older. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If we discover such data, we will delete it immediately.

guidelinesData.title: Changes to This Policy
guidelinesData.description: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page, and continued use of our services signifies your acceptance of the revised policy.
By using Fizzzbee, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
